key_insight: MambaVF replaces costly optical-flow-based fusion with a State Space Model (SSM) formulation that treats video fusion as a sequential state update, enabling temporal modeling without explicit motion estimation and greatly reducing compute overhead.
problem_solved: Removes dependency on optical flow estimation and feature warping in video fusion pipelines, addressing high computational cost, latency, and poor scalability in multi-frame video processing.
method: Reformulate video fusion as a sequential state update process where a compact latent state summarizes past frames and is updated per-frame using an SSM.
Apply efficient SSM-based temporal modeling to fuse multi-frame information without explicit motion estimation or costly feature warping.
Design an end-to-end fusion pipeline that yields competitive visual quality with lower compute and better scalability for longer sequences.
impact: Enables faster, more scalable video fusion suitable for real-time and resource-constrained settings, making multi-frame enhancement/filtering more practical for researchers and deployed systems.
